1879064378.name: Scourging Blow
1879064378.desc: A melee attack dealing additional damage if the enemy suffers from Barbed Arrow.\n\nUsing this skill will stop the bleeding.

conditionalEffects.description: Melee Skills have a chance to generate additional Focus for each enemy hit.

1879102778.name: Strength Signal
1879102778.desc: Extends Strength fellowship skill bonus to your fellowship.

1879139386.name: Invigorating Breath
1879139386.desc: You can recover your morale when you block an enemy's attack.

1879199034.name: Sustaining Bolt
1879199034.desc: A rune-keeper knows that a storm's energy is capable of feeding itself.\n\nThis skill is stronger when used at greater Battle Attunement.

1879205050.name: Lesser Anthem I - Resonance
1879205050.desc: Anthem: Increases your Outgoing Healing and reduces the Induction time of your Healing Skills. Increases Outgoing Healing and reduces Inductions for all nearby fellowship or raid members.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 1 ballad buff present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879213882.name: First Blood (Ranged)
1879213882.desc: Your fellowship strikes at Draigoch's front left leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879227834.name: Ring of Lightning
1879227834.desc: Harness the power of Lightning to provide a powerful offensive boon to an ally without a ring.

1879233850.name: War-steed: Medium
1879233850.desc: The Rouncey is a moderately armoured War-steed. The Rouncey provides balance and stability without sacrificing or favouring survivability or maneuverability.

1879244858.name: Clash of Steel and Will
1879244858.desc: This quick strike saps your target's morale and has a chance on a critical strike to restore power to you and your war-steed.

1879245626.name: Discipline: Rohirrim
1879245626.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline turns your attention to supporting your allies through the use of healing runes and script.

1879247418.name: a mounted ranged attack
1879247418.desc: You auto-attack when wielding a bow.

1879247802.name: Horn Blast
1879247802.desc: The Champion uses his battle-horn to drive fear into the hearts of his enemies and their steeds.

1879254074.name: Keen Strike
1879254074.desc: A keen edged blade and razor wit can combine to truly potent effect. Burglars can take advantage of the stratagem trick with this keen strike.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill is enhanced by Trick: Stratagem.</rgb>

1879262778.name: Pledge of Protection
1879262778.desc: The greatest pledges of protection come from those who are guardians, as their oath to those who need help cannot be broken by word or by action. But no oath can be taken lightly by the one who promises to protect, as compromises and sacrifices are often required by those who serve a higher purpose.

1879266874.name: Mounted Strike
1879266874.desc: A simple passing attack that increases attacking strength when successful.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879311290.name: Vicious Claws
1879311290.desc: A savage attack that deals damage to your enemy, interrupting their action. Provides additional effects based on your specialization.

procEffects.description: Evading an attack applies an Incoming Healing bonus to you. This can only trigger once every 12 seconds.

1879322298.name: Steed of the Woodland Realm
1879322298.desc: A horse from the Anniversary Festival.

1879365434.name: Muster in Dale
1879365434.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Dale.

1879378362.name: Rustflake Dust Devil
1879378362.desc: Brings out a rustflake dust devil to keep you company.

1879391418.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Elvish Shield-maiden)
1879391418.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879396922.name: Black Marble Wolf-dog
1879396922.desc: Brings out a friendly wolf-dog to keep you company.

1879399226.name: Ice Flower Steed
1879399226.desc: A noble steed dressed for the season.

1879422266.name: Spirit Capture
1879422266.desc: Hold the crystal aloft to reveal hidden fell spirits!

1879451322.name: Fungal Bloom
1879451322.desc: Salves of foul herbs and liquids from the depths of Angmar relieve the sting of wounds on the flesh of foul creatures, and increase their ability to inflict wounds.

1879469242.name: Nature's Wrath (Dual)
1879469242.desc: You maul the enemy with a furious attack, gaining Wrath.

1879482554.name: Chestnut Sand Worm
1879482554.desc: Summons a chestnut sand worm to accompany you on your travels.

1879486010.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Temamir Guard)
1879486010.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879491514.name: Guide to Maurûsh
1879491514.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Ub Nishir, near Maurûsh in Urash Dâr in the Ikorbân Valley.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879506362.name: Able Ice-shore Fisher
1879506362.desc: Summons a bear to accompany you on your fishing adventures.

1879506618.name: Wisp of Acid
1879506618.desc: The wicked have learned to recover magical sustenance from the infliction of pain.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Acid Wisp, Spike, and Breath gain the ability to tier up the Pitted Armaments effect if present, up to Tier 3.

1879506746.name: Sorcerous Bolt
1879506746.desc: You launch a bolt of sorcerous energy at a target.
